reviewer: Claude source, predicate and witness review
scope: robolab BananaInBowlTask at the pinned revision; seed 0 witness only. Semantic projection of the official predicate, not physical qualification of other seeds or scenes.
task_language: Pick up the banana and place it in the bowl

predicate_and_helpers.basis: Read BananaInBowlTerminations.success, object_in_container, in_opentop_container, in_contact and gripper_detached.

reset_and_randomization.basis: Scene banana_bowl.usda with banana, bowl and table; seed selects the upstream reset event.

assets_and_frames.basis: Container test is in the bowl's local frame, so a tipped bowl fails.

success_timing.basis: DoneTerm success is evaluated every control step; RoboLab freezes the episode at success and the ORA session latches it.

public_observability.basis: Banana, bowl and gripper are visible in the over-shoulder and wrist cameras.

success_witness.basis: Witness: banana dropped into the bowl with the robot held away gives the success termination on seed 0.

counterexamples.basis: Witness: banana beside the bowl and the reset state give false.

no_expert_strategy.basis: Clauses state end conditions only; no approach, grasp, route or motion advice.

privacy.basis: No coordinates, thresholds, fixture or object identifiers, joint values or predicate names enter the public text; numeric limits stay in this private record.

conditions.source_basis: object_in_container(object=banana, container=bowl, tolerance=0, require_contact_with=True): centroid within the bowl's local box (open-top slack) and banana-bowl contact.
conditions.interpretation: Banana inside the bowl, touching it.

conditions.source_basis: require_gripper_detached=True: gripper_detached checks no gripper contact above 0.1 N.

conditions.interpretation: Contact force bar and container box slack withheld.

public_clauses: The banana must end up inside the bowl and touching it.
Let go of the banana there: the task is not complete while any part of the gripper still touches it.

counterexamples.case: Banana on the table beside the bowl: false.
Banana in the bowl while still gripped: false by gripper_detached (source-derived, not executed).

limitations: Witness covers seed 0 only and uses direct state edits or scripted moves, never a policy rollout; source-derived negative cases marked as such were not executed.
